blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte has no reason to avoid addressing the prosecution’s evidence already submitted to the Senate impeachment court when the trial resumes on Nov. 9. In a statement on Friday, private prosecutor Lorna Kapuna pointed out that the court had already affirmed the admissibility of key evidence presented by the prosecution. But the evidence would exclude documents from the Commission on Audit (COA), which the court rejected as evidence in a Nov. 5 ruling, saying they had already been presented for the first impeachment article, on the vice president’s alleged misuse of confidential […]...
